**IEEE 802.11s** is a wireless local area network (WLAN) standard and an [IEEE 802.11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_802.11 "IEEE 802.11")
 amendment for [mesh networking](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wireless_mesh_network "Wireless mesh network")
, defining how wireless devices can interconnect to create a [wireless LAN](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wireless_LAN "Wireless LAN")
 mesh network, which may be used for relatively fixed (not mobile) topologies and [wireless ad hoc networks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wireless_ad_hoc_network "Wireless ad hoc network")
